title: Can Rassvet, 'Russia's Starlink' change the course of the war in Ukraine?
summary: SpaceX's US Starlink satellite system has played a key role in countering the Russian military in Ukraine, but now a Russian counterpart is under development. What could this mean for Ukraine in future?

title: EU leaders seek agreement on long-term budget and Ukraine at summit
summary: Leaders of the EU's 27 member states are expected to thrash out the EU's budget for 2028 to 2034. Ukraine and European Central Bank leadership are also up for discussion. DW has more.

title: Extreme weather threatens Thanksgiving festivities in US
summary: A major storm is forecast to move up the US East Coast and is likely to cause travel delays. Weather warnings were enough to postpone Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade for the first time in its 100 years.

title: FedEx plane overshoots runway at Miami airport on Thanksgiving eve
summary: A FedEx plane from Memphis ran past the end of a runway at Miami airport, shutting most runways and causing delays of several hours on the eve of the US holiday.

title: Germany: 2 arrested, suspected of plotting synagogue attack
summary: Federal prosecutors say they have ordered the arrest of two members of a pro-Iranian group on suspicion of planning an attack on a synagogue. They were detained in the cities of Heidelberg and Cologne.

title: Germany news: Final budget debate continues in Bundestag
summary: Spending for federal police and domestic intelligence are high on the agenda for parliamentary debate this Thursday. An alleged spy and suspected terrorists are also making in Germany this Thursday. DW has more.

title: How Chinese companies circumvent chips sanctions in Southeast Asia
summary: High-tech AI chips are hard to get in China because of US restrictions. To get around this, Chinese companies often use offshore computing capacity, particularly in Southeast Asia. The US is also trying to stop it.

title: India news: Resolve tariff concerns in trade talks — India tells US
summary: India has denied US claims that New Delhi's policies promote excess manufacturing capacity. Further headlines from India include Constitution Day celebrations. DW has more.

title: Kim Jong Un tours nuclear material sites, urges wider use of tactical nuclear weapons
summary: North Korea's Kim Jong Un visited sites that produce nuclear material and told his military to focus on tactical weapons, saying his country's nuclear status is irreversible.

title: Russia-Ukraine war extends to the Baltic and the Mediterranean
summary: By attacking Russian vessels around the world, Kyiv is trying to up the pressure on Moscow and also sending out signals to its Western allies. What is the impact on global maritime trade?

title: US court blocks regulator's early review of ABC's broadcast licenses
summary: The FCC chairman had ordered an early review of ABC's licenses a day after President Donald Trump called for the broadcaster to fire Jimmy Kimmel earlier this year. The licenses were not set to expire until 2028.
